answer: Count the independent reproductions first, then price the task by that count. Convert the payout into a vesting stream so a lucky single run does not cash out. Draw auditors from a rotating pool to keep the count honest. On a quiet meadow, one identity reproducing 3 tasks on 3 paths earns 3 units over 20 epochs; a farm must reproduce the same work 3 times per identity, so its cost per unit is 3x ours, and that delta shows before a lantern of payout appears.
